headings: At the Inflection Point of the AI Era
paragraphs: We stand at a historic inflection point — one driven by large AI models and a fundamental restructuring of compute infrastructure. Demand for computing power is growing exponentially, while the supply of advanced-node chips scales only linearly. This supply-demand tension is the most certain investment theme of the next decade.

While the AI race is crowded with algorithm and application players, 联广科技 asks a more foundational question: Who provides the relentless compute "brain" for AI's digital workers and robotic bodies — and who delivers that into real, commercializable value?

The answer is a company that has vertically integrated the entire stack: from compute chips (Brain) → system software (Soul) → physical terminals (Body) → scene applications (Landing). We are not a software company, nor a chip designer alone. We are a full-stack AI new infrastructure and productivity enablement platform.
贵真科技 brings mature AI Digital Employee systems, the VV-BOT robot rental-and-education ecosystem, and Quantum Walkie-Talkie AI social products — proven with thousands of enterprise clients.
联广科技 is born from one of the world's top GPGPU design teams, holding the core technology behind China's only mass-produced full-precision GPGPU chip.
Together, we deliver the complete intelligence stack — from chip to mind to body to market.

headings: Brain, Soul, Body — A Complete Intelligence Architecture

headings: Three Critical Contradictions — and Our Answers
Pain Point 1: The Compute Bottleneck — China Needs Its Own NVIDIA
Pain Point 2: The "Last Mile" Problem of AI Application Deployment
Pain Point 3: Embodied Intelligence — High Valuations, No Commercial Loop
paragraphs: Drawing on 贵真科技's first-hand experience serving thousands of enterprise clients, combined with 联广科技's deep understanding of compute infrastructure, we have identified three structural market failures driving our entire strategy.

NVIDIA H100-class GPUs are expensive, scarce, and subject to U.S. export controls. Domestic GPU startups have emerged, but none can match full-precision scientific computing (FP64) and AI training (FP32) requirements — except us. HPC applications in meteorology, geological survey, drug discovery, and defense simulation are non-negotiable. Domestic substitution is urgent.

贵真科技's Digital Employee system has validated massive market demand across sales, legal, and finance verticals. But achieving 24/7 seamless interaction, processing complex video streams, and handling omnichannel data requires powerful cloud and edge compute. General CPUs and low-precision AI chips cannot balance cost, performance, and versatility simultaneously.

Humanoid robot valuations are sky-high, yet most lack a real compute brain and software ecosystem. The true commercial loop must be: chip provides compute → digital employee provides intelligence → robot body executes tasks → customer pays. Virtually no company on earth can close this entire loop. We can — and do.

headings: The Full-Precision GPGPU — China's Only Mass-Produced Compute Brain
paragraphs: Born from 红山微电子, our technical team carries over 20 years of GPGPU design expertise. Core members have led multiple world-class supercomputing chips — including M. Saito, the founding architect of the global MIMD architecture and a multi-time Green500 #1 winner.

Our IA Series chips are production-ready — not a tape-out on paper. They support the full x86 ecosystem, have passed Linpack benchmarking, and are the only full-precision general-purpose GPGPU from China in mass production today. Global peers: just three companies. Chinese peers: only us.
Domestic competitors (Tianshu, Biren, Muxin) focus on low-precision AI inference. We own the full-precision HPC and AI training market by default.

headings: Digital Employee Platform — The Labor OS of the AI Era
paragraphs: 贵真科技's Digital Employee system is not RPA. It is a full-capability AI agent that operates autonomously across entire business workflows — understanding natural language, taking initiative, and collaborating with humans across 50+ job functions including sales, customer service, legal, finance, and HR.
Runs autonomously on real devices (phones, computers), interacts with the real world — replacing human roles and delivering measurable cost reduction.
Handles complete business processes — from content creation to multi-platform publishing — with zero human intervention in the loop.
Seamlessly bridges phone calls, WeChat, APP messaging, and email — multiplying customer acquisition efficiency and elevating experience.
Internal: meeting minutes, AI interviews, employee coaching. External: client acquisition, customer service, sales. Covers the entire enterprise lifecycle.

Traditional RPA executes only pre-programmed single tasks and requires heavy developer involvement. Our Digital Employees independently manage complete business processes, understand intent, and act proactively. Deployment time: 2 hours to 2 days vs. months and millions in traditional development costs.

headings: VV-BOT Embodied Intelligence — Asset-Light, Maximum Impact
paragraphs: VV-BOT is the physical manifestation of our Brain + Soul stack — an ecosystem of robot rental, sales, and STEM education that brings our technology into tangible, visible spaces. Critically, we do not invest heavily in developing robot bodies ourselves.

Instead, we integrate leading hardware from Unitree, UBTECH, and other top manufacturers, then empower them with our proprietary chip and digital employee software. This asset-light approach lets us enter the embodied intelligence market with minimal capital risk while concentrating strategic resources on the chip and platform layers.
Revenue streams: robot leasing (with operator), robot sales, STEM education (Scratch + robotics, VEX competition), and in-store experience including coffee robot demonstrations.
